location_qualifier: off Cape Esperance, third Ke-Go evacuation run
source_locator: R2250: C08030022900, 經過, ソロモン方面, 7 February 1943 (PDF p. 23, 二―七). R2242: 7 February 1943
current_activity: in the final Ke-Go evacuation run off Cape Esperance, near-missed by air attack
notes: JACAR 8th Fleet February 經過 (C08030022900, PDF p. 23) names this ship in the ケ号作戦 第三次輸送 table, dated 二―7, at エスペ (Cape Esperance). Cressman, 7 February 1943, independently names this unit in Rear Admiral Hashimoto Shintaro's Operation KE evacuation force off Guadalcanal / Cape Esperance; Cressman names Urakaze as near-missed. Completion on 8 February (Cressman) is the night of 7–8; the claim follows JACAR's 7 February table date. Confidence 0.7: JACAR (jacar) and Cressman (us_navy_nhhc) agree on the unit, the day, and the place. Recovered-personnel totals in the diary were not used as campaign figures (they do not match Cressman's published extract numbers).
